title.en: Abolishing the Special Trade Representative Offices in Frankfurt, West Germany and in Kuwait
title.orig: Abolishing the Special Trade Representative Offices in Frankfurt, West Germany and in Kuwait

text.en:
The Special Trade Representative Offices in Frankfurt, West Germany and in Kuwait are hereby
abolished and their functions, including records, equipment, property and such personnel as may be necessary,
are transferred to the Commercial Posts concerned in the areas where the Special Trade Representative
Offices are presently located or as may be otherwise determined by the Minister of Trade. The Minister of the
Budget shall reallocate the appropriations provided for the abolished offices, acting on recommendation of the
Minister of Trade.

The Minister of Trade is hereby directed to hasten the implementation of Executive Order No. 574 and
Executive Order No. 540 to establish a more effective mechanism for the diversification, expansion and
promotion of the country's foreign trade.

All laws, decrees, charters, executive orders, administrative orders, proclamation, rules and regulations
or parts thereof that are in conflict with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-one.
